crm_notes: Buyer: Ian Chen, VP Product (SaaS product team). Wants internal IT/helpdesk bot to be fast and auditable.
Quote from Ian: 'We need <300ms response-start for short answers, and full transcript persisted for audits.'
Primary workload: chat-first agent that calls internal tools (ticket lookup, user disable) via tool-calling hooks.
Latency goals: response-start streaming <300ms 95p, end-to-end action completion <1s for cached lookups, throughput ~80 rps during peak.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, willing to pay premium for predictable latency; leaning Hosted to start but wants Dedicated pricing for 6-12 month commit.
Security: Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year with export, KMS integration for key management, optional data residency in us-east.
POC success criteria: 95th pct streaming start <350ms, tool-call isolation (no data bleed), audit logs available in near-real-time, embedding/rerank accuracy comparable to baseline.
Notes on model choice: prefer open model variants initially (cost) with fallback to quantized larger model for complex escalations.
Trial notes: using Redwood-hosted streaming endpoints. Observability dashboard shared; team asked for per-route token cost breakdown and token-level tail latency.
